label: Rigid initial profile, bearer omission and transfer triad checked (inference)
rule: Rigid preservation and initial-to-presence soundness applied at an included witness
meaning: Incompatible triad: under the rigid M profile any conceived history without the actual initial bearer is M-inadmissible, so a conceivability-based case for its possibility must supply restricted inclusion, which the rigid profile denies. Conditional on internal hypotheses; neither refutes fixed-history necessity nor establishes it.
